allowed: Pinned sample, predeadline task definitions/assets and declared ranges. Development variants must record independently chosen distributions and seeds.
excluded: Post-release eval_config.yaml, its exact scene constants, and variants seeded from those scenes; observed post-release evaluation failures must not select route constants, data, or thresholds.
limitations: Already viewed qualification scenes are exposed tests, not untouched holdouts. Existing model/data/prior eligibility requires provenance audit, not a blanket assumption of clean or contaminated.
